about: design/standard/javascript/netgen-layouts.js = the bundle of netgen/layouts-ui 2.0.0 (base) with header.js in front and the modules listed here replaced by their files. Commits in parentheses are those of se7enxweb/explayouts_ui_api. Built and checked by apply.mjs, tested by tests/js/app-patches.test.mjs.
header_changes: Interface texts through nglT()/nglTh(), translated from window.explayoutsSpaI18n (d4a02cf)
Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)
The page's jQuery UI is no longer used: the drag and drop is the editor's own (modules 135-138)
The page's jQuery is no longer used either: module jquery is the editor's own DOM layer

modules.name: ./core_base | ../core_base
changes: Core.ui: the plain DOM helpers, dialog, collapse and dropdown that ./extended/jquery_override builds from bootstrap/js/transition, modal, collapse and dropdown (handed on as jQuery.ngl_ui); ./lib/jquery/* add their helpers to it.

modules.name: ./environments/default | ../../environments/default | ../environments/default
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)

modules.name: ./extended/backbone_override
changes: Page title suffix and the HTTP method of create_new_draft (d3d3488)

modules.name: ./extended/jquery_override
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)
ajax_submit sends a form without a method attribute as POST (the API takes form saves as POST only; jQuery's default GET also hid the save from the warning on leaving).
browser_tabs makes WAI-ARIA tabs: tablist, tab and tabpanel roles, aria-selected with a roving tabindex, one selected tab, arrow keys, Home and End (3df5f1e)

Bootstrap 3's jQuery plugins are gone: bootstrap/js/transition, dropdown, modal and collapse are plain DOM code now and are put together here as Core.ui (jQuery.ngl_ui for ./core_base). The dropup placement moved to bootstrap/js/dropdown, xeditable to ./lib/jquery/video_thumb_fetcher, dependable_select to ./lib/jquery/master_slave_selects; the jQuery core extensions (toJSON, html/text, ajax_submit, closest_view, browser_tabs ...) stay.

No jQuery on the page any more: the module no longer sets window.jQuery and window.ngc_jquery, and the $.fn.modal bridge is gone (explayouts-app.js calls Core.ui.dialog). Its own collection methods (toJSON, html/text, ajax_submit, browser_tabs ...) are added to the editor's DOM layer (module jquery).

modules.name: ./extended/model | ./model
changes: save_via_form keeps the state of the form it sent (Core.form_state) on the form element as nglSaved once the save succeeded, for the warning on leaving (module 23).

modules.name: ./extended/view | ../extended/view
changes: A view is also found from its element without jQuery: el.ngl_view, beside the jQuery data _view (for the inline switches, .xeditable).
The view is kept on its element only as el.ngl_view; the DOM layer (module jquery) reads and writes .data("_view") there, so the jQuery data and the property are one.

modules.name: ./helpers
changes: The template helper date formats through the module moment, now Intl.DateTimeFormat instead of Moment.js (same output for en, en-US, en-GB, de, de-DE, de-AT, fr, it; other locales follow the browser's CLDR conventions).

modules.name: ./init
changes: A missing layout: the 404 dialog leads back to the admin instead of creating an empty layout (11de65f)
Interface texts through nglT()/nglTh(), translated from window.explayoutsSpaI18n (d4a02cf)
Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)
A refused change (403 with reason access_denied) is reported as not allowed, not as a session timeout (68bcdae)

Leaving the editor warns only with unsaved changes: while a request other than GET runs, within a second of typing in a block's inline text (saved 500 ms after the last key), or while a form of the sidebar or of a dialog differs from what was last loaded or saved (Core.has_unsaved_changes, Core.form_state). The original warned on every leave that was not publish, discard or close.

reinitialize_plugins calls the plain helpers on Core.ui (xeditable, dependable_select, master_slave_selects, video_thumb_fetcher, view_types, bm_tooltip) with the view's elements instead of the jQuery plugins.

modules.name: ./lib/jquery/bm_tooltip
changes: bm_tooltip is a plain function, Core.ui.bm_tooltip( elements ), instead of the jQuery plugin $.fn.bm_tooltip.

modules.name: ./lib/jquery/master_slave_selects
changes: master_slave_selects and dependable_select (from ./extended/jquery_override) are plain functions on Core.ui with native change handlers; the option chosen in the slave select gets a native change event (bubbling, as jQuery's trigger did); show/hide with Core.ui.show/hide.

modules.name: ./lib/jquery/video_thumb_fetcher
changes: video_thumb_fetcher is a plain function, Core.ui.video_thumb_fetcher( elements ), the Vimeo thumbnail fetched with fetch(); the inline switches .xeditable (Core.ui.xeditable and their click handlers, from ./extended/jquery_override) are here, without jQuery.

modules.name: ./lib/jquery/view_types
changes: View type select: a change saves the form; the select carries js-skip-on-change, so only the master select of a master/slave pair was saved (6977a49)

The master select of a master/slave pair (a list's View type) is saved too when the new view type leaves no item view type to choose (list_zigzag, list_accordion, a view type of your own): the form is submitted once the item view type select has been updated; when that already saved the form, the second submit sends the same values and is skipped

view_types is a plain function, Core.ui.view_types( elements ), with a native change handler; the form is submitted with a native submit event (the form view handles it; nothing is ever sent the browser's way).

modules.name: ./application
changes: The editor asks for the draft with fallback=published: a layout without a draft answers with its published version (200) instead of a 404 the browser logs as an error, and the editor creates the draft as it did after the 404.

Right after create_new_draft (fresh_draft is the route's layout) the page keeps the draft the POST answered with instead of reading the layout again: that read could still answer with the published layout (a revalidation the server answered 304 within the same second), and the editor then asked for the draft again, three to six times per opening. One draft request per opening now.

Escape with the focus outside the toggle and the menu (the click that opened the menu also selected its block, and the block's rich text editor took the focus) still closes an open menu; the focus stays and the key goes on to its other listeners

modules.name: bootstrap/js/modal
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)

Plain DOM code instead of Bootstrap 3.4.1's modal.js: same markup, classes, backdrop, body class, scrollbar padding, Escape and backdrop click; in addition role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-hidden, Tab kept in the open dialog and the focus given back on close; on_shown/on_hidden callbacks and DOM events show/shown/hide/hidden.bs.modal.

A dialog shown again while it still fades out, or closed while it still fades in, is turned round where it stands: the transition under way is dropped, so no second backdrop appears and no display none, aria-hidden or focus move of the old close lands on the dialog open again (the content browser's Cancel followed at once by Add items).

modules.name: bootstrap/js/transition
changes: Plain DOM helpers (Core.ui) instead of Bootstrap 3.4.1's transition.js: transition end with a time limit, jQuery-like show/hide with a duration, visibility, tabbable elements, events.

modules.name: ./core
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)
Empty: jQuery UI's core is not needed any more, the drag and drop is the editor's own (modules 135-138); jQuery UI is no longer loaded

modules.name: jquery-ui/draggable | ./draggable
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)

The editor's own draggables and droppables on Pointer Events (mouse, touch, pen), plain DOM, in place of jQuery UI's draggable/droppable: what ./bm_collection_items uses (axis, clone helper, handle, zIndex, appendTo; accept, activeClass, hoverClass, tolerance; start/stop/over/out/drop), Escape cancels; activeClass/hoverClass work again (jQuery UI 1.14 had dropped them without $.uiBackCompat)

Keyboard entries for module 139 (keyStart, keyTargets, keyOver, keyDrop): a manual item of a dynamic collection is moved onto another slot with the keys through the same start/activate/drop/deactivate/stop callbacks as with the pointer, so it is saved with the same $move; each draggable is handed to ./widget when its grips are marked

A handle drawn again inside a draggable gets its classes again (touch-action: none hangs on them); a drop or stop callback that throws leaves no droppable marked and no helper behind, so the next drag works.

modules.name: jquery-ui/droppable
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)
Hands out droppable() of ./draggable (module 135) in place of jQuery UI's droppable

modules.name: ./mouse
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)

The gesture of the editor's drag and drop in place of jQuery UI's mouse widget: Pointer Events for mouse, touch and pen with jQuery UI's delay/distance, one press at a time (innermost list first), Escape and pointercancel cancel, no text selection or native drag on a mouse press, the click ending a drag swallowed (never a keyboard click); auto-scroll near the scroll parent's edge while the pointer stays there, as in admin4's sub items drag

Auto-scroll with the pointer held still moves the placeholder along: the scrolled distance counts as a move of the pointer. A start callback that throws ends the drag as cancelled (everything put back, the press released) and the error goes on, instead of leaving the press set and the drag and drop dead until the page is loaded again.

modules.name: jquery-ui/sortable
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)

The editor's own sortable lists on Pointer Events, plain DOM, in place of jQuery UI's sortable: what ./dnd and ./bm_collection_items use, with jQuery UI's callbacks in jQuery UI's order (checked against 1.14.2 in tests/js/dnd.test.mjs); ui holds elements and a per-drag object; cancel(list) also after the drop; Escape cancels; geometry read live; scrollParent replaces the customScrollParent patch

Keyboard entries for module 139 (keyStart, keyMove, keyDrop, keyCancel): a drag without a pointer through the same callbacks in the same order (start, activate, over, out, change, update, remove, receive, deactivate, stop), so a keyboard move is saved exactly as a pointer move; the item itself travels and keeps the focus of its grip, placeholder and helper stay hidden; each list is handed to ./widget when its grips are marked

The grips of items drawn again (a block's header, a collection item's handle) are marked again: the list watches its whole subtree, batched once per change, so touch-action: none and the keyboard grip are not lost after a block is rendered anew; a callback throwing during the drop or its cancelling still ends the drag (helper and placeholder removed, the list free for the next drag).

modules.name: ./widget
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)
Empty: jQuery UI's widget factory is not needed any more (modules 135-138)

The keyboard mode of the drag and drop, in place of the empty module: the grips of blocks, block types and collection items become buttons with a name and a hint; Space/Enter picks up and drops, the arrow keys move (into the zone before or after at a zone's edge), Home/End, Alt+arrow moves one place at once, Escape or leaving the grip cancels; linked zones, zones that refuse the block type and container placeholders for container blocks are skipped as the pointer's callbacks refuse them; every step said in one polite live region through nglT(); after a drop the grip keeps the focus, also when the editor draws the block or item again; reduced motion respected

The list watcher moved to module 138, which hands each list here whenever it marks its grips again. Keeping the focus on a dropped item's grip stops as soon as the user presses, types or focuses anywhere else, instead of pulling the focus back for up to five seconds; a callback throwing while an item is picked up leaves nothing picked up.

modules.name: jquery
changes: Runs on the page's jQuery 4 and jQuery UI 1.14 (ezjscore) instead of the jQuery 2.2.4 and jQuery UI 1.10.4 built in; explayouts names for page tags and globals (8273a03)

jQuery is no longer used: the module is the editor's own DOM layer, the part of jQuery the bundle calls (collections, events with delegation and namespaces, data, $.ajax with its global events, $.Deferred, $.when, $.param, $.extend) on plain DOM, so that the page loads no jQuery. Backbone and the app reach it as Backbone.$ and Core.$.
Scripts in HTML handed to append, after and replaceWith (strings, or nodes parsed by the layer) run when they reach the document, once, as with jQuery; until now only html() ran them.

modules.name: moment/min/locales.min
changes: Moment.js's locales are no longer part of the bundle; the module is empty.

modules.name: moment | ../moment
changes: Moment.js is no longer part of the bundle: a small date formatter on Intl.DateTimeFormat (format, parse) for the template helper date.
